title: Network downloads
description: Download M3U8 streams, public Douyin videos or magnets to this computer.
addressHint: Paste the full URL, or the entire Douyin share message.
toolsMissing: Video downloads require local FFmpeg and ffprobe. Install both and restart. Magnet downloads are available without them.
emptyHint: Paste a URL or import a playlist, then select quality and start downloading.
assistantAllowed: Allow assistant downloads on this computer
interrupted: Interrupted on exit. Parse the source again.

error.SETTINGS_SAVE_FAILED: Settings were not saved. Check local disk space and permissions, then try again.
error.DOWNLOAD_ASSISTANT_DISABLED: Assistant downloads are disabled. Enable them in device settings.
error.DOWNLOAD_INVALID_SOURCE: Enter a valid download link, magnet URI or Douyin share message.
error.IMPORT_DOWNLOAD_LINK_NEEDED: Could not get the video from this file. Paste the link used to download the M3U8 file and select the file again, or use the browser extension.
error.DOWNLOAD_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The source is unavailable or expired. Obtain a new URL.
error.DOWNLOAD_NETWORK: The network connection failed. Try again later.
error.DOWNLOAD_UNSUPPORTED: Unsupported source: live streams and DRM are unavailable. Magnets must be public BitTorrent v1; pure v2 and private torrents are unsupported.
error.DOWNLOAD_LIMIT: Limit exceeded: video 10 GiB / 20,000 segments; magnets 100 GiB selected / 10,000 files; metadata 4 MiB.
error.DOWNLOAD_INVALID_MEDIA: The file or metadata failed validation and was not published.
error.DOWNLOAD_STORAGE: Could not save the file. Check folder permissions and hard-link support.
error.DOWNLOAD_NO_SPACE: The disk of the download folder is running out of space. Free some space or choose another download folder.
error.DOWNLOAD_TOOLS_UNAVAILABLE: Local FFmpeg or ffprobe was not found. Install both and restart.
error.DOWNLOAD_PROCESSING: Could not merge the video. Its codecs may be incompatible with MP4.
error.DOWNLOAD_EXPIRED: The preview expired. Parse the source again.
error.DOWNLOAD_BUSY: The queue is full or the task is still running. Try again later.
error.unknown: The operation did not complete. Try again.
error.DOWNLOAD_CREDENTIALS_UNAVAILABLE: The system keychain is unavailable. Resume credentials could not be saved or read.
error.DOWNLOAD_METADATA_UNAVAILABLE: No peer supplied the file list. Check that the torrent has available peers and try again.

magnetHint: Public BitTorrent v1 magnets are supported. Metadata can take 90 seconds. Upload is limited to 256 KiB/s per task and stops on completion, pause or exit. Resume after restarting.
